result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback: it is mutual, applies only to each party’s directly involved personnel, expires no later than 12 months after the individual’s involvement ends, retains carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches, and prohibits solicitation rather than hiring. The changes are appropriately limited and preserve the clause’s unrelated intent. Drafting is generally professional, though “performance or receipt of this Agreement” would be clearer as “performance or receipt of the services,” and the timing could be stated more directly as 12 months after the end of each person’s involvement.
